title: Crexendo’s CAIRO AI Receptionist Wins 2026 Voice AI Technology Excellence Award, Reinforcing Company’s Strategy to Drive Growth Through AI Innovation
summary: Crexendo’s CAIRO AI Receptionist wins the 2026 CUSTOMER Magazine Voice AI Technology Excellence Award for intelligent call handling and orchestration.
body_markdown:
**PHOENIX, AZ /[ACCESS Newswire](https://www.accessnewswire.com/) / November 17, 2026 /** Crexendo®, Inc. (NASDAQ:CXDO), an award-winning software technology company supporting over 8 million end-users, and a premier provider of cloud communication platform software and unified communications as a service (UCaaS) offerings, including voice, video, contact center, and managed IT services tailored to businesses of all sizes, today announced that it has been honored with the 2026 CUSTOMER Magazine Voice AI Technology Excellence Award for CAIRO, the Crexendo AI Receptionist and Orchestrator.


Beyond improving the customer experience, CAIRO represents an important component of Crexendo’s strategy to accelerate organic growth through AI-powered solutions. By providing advanced AI capabilities through its NetSapiens cloud communications platform, it will create additional revenue opportunities for both the Company and its growing ecosystem of service provider licensees. As businesses increasingly seek intelligent automation to improve productivity, reduce operating costs, and enhance customer engagement, CAIRO and its expanding portfolio of AI solutions can drive increased adoption, create opportunities for additional recurring revenue, and strengthen the long-term value of the NetSapiens platform. Crexendo’s CAIRO helps organizations improve satisfaction, streamline operations, and drive stronger customer relationships by delivering seamless, responsive, and highly personalized customer experiences. CAIRO was selected for its ability to leverage Voice AI to enhance customer engagement through intelligent call handling, automation, and orchestration capabilities.


“On behalf of TMC and CUSTOMER magazine, I extend our congratulations to all of the 2026 Voice AI Technology Excellence Award winners,” said Rich Tehrani, CEO of TMC. “The recipients recognized today represent some of the most innovative and impactful companies in voice technology. Their commitment to excellence, customer success, and continuous innovation is helping shape the future of communications.”


“We are extremely pleased that CAIRO has received this prestigious recognition, further validating our commitment to making Crexendo and our NetSapiens platform leaders in AI-powered cloud communications,” said Jeff Korn, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Crexendo. “We believe artificial intelligence represents one of the most significant opportunities to accelerate our organic growth and create meaningful new revenue streams for Crexendo and our licensees. CAIRO is an important part of that strategy, providing businesses with powerful AI capabilities that can improve customer engagement, increase efficiency, and reduce operating costs.”


Korn added “What makes this opportunity particularly exciting is our ability to bring these innovations to an established and growing ecosystem supporting more than eight million end users. As AI adoption accelerates, we believe our expanding portfolio of AI solutions can generate additional recurring revenue, increase the value of our platform to existing customers, attract new licensees, and provide a meaningful catalyst for our long-term growth. This award is another important validation of our technology and the substantial opportunity we see ahead.”


Earning an Excellence Award from TMC’s CUSTOMER magazine instantly elevates the Crexendo brand, raising the company’s stature before TMC’s extensive and educated audience of technology professionals, decision makers, and executives, and their entire eco-system of end users and other providers.


This latest recognition underscores Crexendo’s influence on the future of customer engagement through intelligent cloud communications. The company continues to advance its innovation leadership by delivering an AI-powered software platform that helps businesses improve operational efficiency and deliver superior customer experiences.


**About Crexendo**
Crexendo, Inc. is an award-winning software technology company that is a premier provider of cloud communication platform and services, video collaboration and managed IT services tailored to businesses of all sizes. The Company’s solutions currently support over eight million end users globally through its extensive global network of over 250 cloud communication platform software subscribers and its direct retail offering. For more information, please visit[www.crexendo.com](https://pr.report/tn05) .

Winners represent prominent players in the market who consistently demonstrate the advancement of technologies. Each recipient is a verifiable leader in the marketplace.
